Traitement Indice acoustique
Import des excel 5 et 10m avec les varibales Enr sur DF_IA10 et DF_IA10
```{r}
chemin <- "~/Césure/Tahiti/Data_IA_Tahiti_10m_Pro"
fichiers_xlsx <- list.files(
  chemin,
  pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz <- lapply(fichiers_xlsx, read_excel)
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz  <- bind_rows(lapply(fichiers_xlsx, read_excel))
```

Nettoyage des indices acoustiques et on garde une ligne par fichier
```{r}
IA_10m_0.3_8Khz <- IA_10m_0.3_8Khz %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>%
  select(-ADI_val.left_band_values,
         -ADI_val.left_bandrange_values) %>%
  rename(Enr = projet)
IA_10m <- IA_10m_0.3_8Khz %>%
  group_by(Enr, fichier) %>%
  summarise(
    ACI = first(ACI_val),
    ADI = first(ADI_val.adi_left),
    AEI  = first(AEI_val.aei_left),
    BIO  = first(BIO_val.left_area),
    H = first(H_val),
    M = first(M_val),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

DF_IA10 <- IA_10m %>%
  left_join(
    Data_Globale_Tahiti,
    by = "Enr"
  ) %>%
  select(-Fichier,
         -EAA)
```
Ajoute de variable heure pour analyse temporelle
Pareil pour DF_IA10
```{r}
# Nettoyer le nom (ignorer _000, sans modifier la colonne fichier)
f_clean <- sub("_[0-9]{3}(?=\\.wav$)", "", DF_IA10$fichier, perl = TRUE)
# Construire un datetime fiable depuis le nom du fichier
DF_IA10$datetime <- as.POSIXct(
  paste(
    substr(f_clean, 10, 17),  # YYYYMMDD
    substr(f_clean, 19, 24)   # HHMMSS
  ),
  format = "%Y%m%d %H%M%S",
  tz = "Pacific/Tahiti"
)
# Colonnes pratiques, vérifier que la tz, time zone match bien, sinon ca peut modifier nos dates.
DF_IA10$date  <- as.Date(DF_IA10$datetime, tz = "Pacific/Tahiti")
DF_IA10$heure <- format(DF_IA10$datetime, "%H:%M", tz = "Pacific/Tahiti")
DF_IA10$heure_num <- as.numeric(format(DF_IA10$datetime, "%H", tz = "Pacific/Tahiti"))
DF_IA10 <- DF_IA10[order(DF_IA10$Enr, DF_IA10$datetime), ]
```

Ajout data météo quotidienne, précipitation jour et Température max
On fait la même chose pour DF_IA 10
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
Data_Meteo10 <- read_excel("Data_temp_prec.xlsx")

DF_IA10$date <- as.Date(DF_IA10$date)
Data_Meteo10$date <- as.Date(Data_Meteo10$date)
Data_Meteo10$rr <- as.numeric(Data_Meteo10$rr)
Data_Meteo10$tx <- as.numeric(Data_Meteo10$tx)

DF_IA10 <- DF_IA10 %>%
  mutate(id_row = row_number())
# Split stations précip
prec_long <- DF_IA10 %>%
  dplyr::select(id_row, date, Station_Prec) %>%
  separate_rows(Station_Prec, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(Station_Prec = trimws(Station_Prec))
# Join météo
prec_join <- prec_long %>%
  left_join(
    Data_Meteo10 %>% dplyr::select(nom_usuel, date, rr),
    by = c("Station_Prec" = "nom_usuel", "date" = "date")
  )
# Moyenne par ligne originale 
prec_mean <- prec_join %>%
  group_by(id_row) %>%
  summarise(rr_meteo = mean(rr, na.rm = TRUE))

temp_long <- DF_IA10 %>%
  dplyr::select(id_row, date, Station_Temp) %>%
  separate_rows(Station_Temp, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(Station_Temp = trimws(Station_Temp))

temp_join <- temp_long %>%
  left_join(
    Data_Meteo10 %>% dplyr::select(nom_usuel, date, tx),
    by = c("Station_Temp" = "nom_usuel", "date" = "date")
  )
temp_mean <- temp_join %>%
  group_by(id_row) %>%
  summarise(tx_meteo = mean(tx, na.rm = TRUE))

DF_IA10 <- DF_IA10 %>%
  left_join(prec_mean, by = "id_row") %>%
  left_join(temp_mean, by = "id_row")
```

Code pour avoir des graph temporels par Commune ou autre, chaque jour est indiqué, les graph sont plus ou moins complet en fonction de quand commence ou se termine les enregistrements.

```{r}
# 1️⃣ Filtrer ILM_Paea et trier proprement
DF_focus <- DF_IA10 %>%
  filter(Commune == "Pirae") %>%
  arrange(date, datetime)

# 2️⃣ Créer un index horaire par jour
#    → 1 = premier enregistrement du jour, quel que soit l'heure réelle
DF_focus <- DF_focus %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  mutate(hour_index = dense_rank(datetime)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3️⃣ Supprimer les journées trop courtes
#    (ici au moins 8 heures mesurées – ajuste si besoin)
min_hours <- 8

DF_focus <- DF_focus %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(hour_index) >= min_hours) %>%
  ungroup()

DF_focus <- DF_focus %>%
  arrange(Enr, datetime) %>%
  group_by(Enr) %>%
  mutate(time_index = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
# 4️⃣ Vérification (optionnelle)
# distinct(date, hour_index, heure) %>% arrange(date, hour_index)
day_breaks <- DF_focus %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(start_index = min(time_index)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(DF_focus,
       aes(x = time_index,
           y = ACI,
           color = Enr,
           group = Enr)) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +

  geom_vline(data = day_breaks,
             aes(xintercept = start_index),
             color = "grey60",
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.4,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = day_breaks$start_index,
    labels = format(day_breaks$date, "%d-%m")
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +

  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "ACI",
    color = "Enregistreur"
  )
```

Dynamique temporelle globale par Habitat, pour tout les sites dispersés dans le temps
```{r}
### 2️⃣ INDEX HORAIRE PAR JOUR
DF_focus <- DF_IA10 %>%
  arrange(date, datetime, heure_num)   %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  mutate(hour_index = dense_rank(datetime)) %>%
  ungroup()
### 2️⃣ MOYENNE + SE PAR HABITAT / DATE / HEURE
DF_hab <- DF_focus %>%
  group_by(Hab, date, heure_num) %>%
  summarise(
    ADI_mean = mean(ADI, na.rm = TRUE),
    ADI_sd   = sd(ADI, na.rm = TRUE),
    n        = n(),
    ADI_se   = ADI_sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
### 3️⃣ CRÉER INDEX TEMPS CONTINU (POUR PLOT)
DF_hab <- DF_hab %>%
  arrange(Hab, date, heure_num) %>%
  group_by(Hab) %>%
  mutate(time_index = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
### 4️⃣ POSITIONS DÉBUT JOURNÉE (LIGNES VERTICALES)
day_breaks <- DF_hab %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(start_index = min(time_index), .groups = "drop")
### 5️⃣ PLOT FINAL
p <- ggplot(DF_hab,
       aes(x = time_index,
           y = ADI_mean,
           color = Hab,
           fill = Hab,
           group = Hab)) +
  # SE ribbon
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ADI_mean - ADI_se,
                  ymax = ADI_mean + ADI_se),
              alpha = 0.2,
              colour = NA) +
  # Ligne moyenne
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  # Lignes verticales changement jour
  geom_vline(data = day_breaks,
             aes(xintercept = start_index),
             color = "grey60",
             linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.4,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Axe X avec dates
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = day_breaks$start_index,
    labels = format(day_breaks$date, "%d-%m")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "ADI moyen",
    color = "Habitat",
    fill = "Habitat"
  )
print(p)
```

```{r}
# Calcul facteur d'échelle
coef <- max(DF_IA10$rr_meteo, na.rm = TRUE) /
        max(DF_IA10$ACI, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(DF_IA10, aes(x = datetime)) +
  
  # Pluie
  geom_line(aes(y = rr_meteo),
            color = "grey30") +
  
  # ACI mis à l’échelle
  geom_line(aes(y = ACI * coef),
            color = "#1f77b4") +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Commune, scales = "free_x") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Rainfall (mm)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~./coef, name = "ACI")
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Day",
    title = "Temporal dynamic of ACI and Rainfall"
  )
```

Graphique de réduction de la variance des indices avec l'effet d'enregistrement acoustique
```{r}
# 1️⃣ Préparer effort réseau
DF_IA10 <- DF_IA10 %>%
  arrange(Enr, datetime) %>%
  group_by(Enr) %>%
  mutate(Hour_rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2️⃣ Effort max commun
max_hour <- DF_IA10 %>%
  group_by(Enr) %>%
  summarise(n = max(Hour_rank)) %>%
  summarise(mean(n)) %>%
  pull()

# 3️⃣ Fonction SE réseau %
calc_network_se <- function(data, var, h){
  vals <- data %>%
    filter(Hour_rank <= h) %>%
    pull({{var}})
  se <- sd(vals, na.rm=TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(vals)))
  mean_val <- mean(vals, na.rm=TRUE)
  (se / mean_val) * 100
}

# 4️⃣ Calcul courbes effort
indices <- c("ACI","ADI","AEI","BIO","H","M")
res_all <- data.frame()
for(ind in indices){
  for(h in 1:max_hour){
    se_val <- calc_network_se(DF_IA10, !!sym(ind), h)
    res_all <- rbind(res_all,
      data.frame(
        Index = ind,
        Effort = h,
        SE = se_val
      )
    )
  }
}

# 5️⃣ Weibull 4 paramètres
weibull_fun <- function(t, Asym, Drop, lrc, pwr){
  Asym + Drop * exp(-(lrc * t)^pwr)
}

# 6️⃣ Fit modèles + SD résiduelle
models <- list()
sd_resid <- data.frame()
for(ind in indices){
  df_ind <- res_all %>% filter(Index == ind)
  mod <- try(
    nls(
      SE ~ weibull_fun(Effort, Asym, Drop, lrc, pwr),
      data = df_ind,
      start = list(
        Asym = min(df_ind$SE, na.rm=TRUE),
        Drop = -diff(range(df_ind$SE, na.rm=TRUE)),
        lrc = 0.5,
        pwr = 0.5
      ),
      control = nls.control(maxiter = 500)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  models[[ind]] <- mod
  if(class(mod)[1] != "try-error"){
    sd_resid <- rbind(
      sd_resid,
      data.frame(
        Index = ind,
        SD = sd(residuals(mod), na.rm=TRUE)
      )
    )
  }
}

# 7️⃣ Prédictions + bandes SD
res_all$Pred <- NA
res_all$SD <- NA
for(ind in indices){
  mod <- models[[ind]]
  if(class(mod)[1] != "try-error"){
    idx <- res_all$Index == ind
    res_all$Pred[idx] <- predict(mod)
    sd_val <- sd_resid$SD[sd_resid$Index == ind]
    res_all$SD[idx] <- sd_val
  }
}
res_all <- res_all %>%
  mutate(
    Pred_low = Pred - SD,
    Pred_high = Pred + SD
  )
# 8️⃣ Figure publication style
ggplot(res_all, aes(Effort, SE, color = Index)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Pred), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = Pred_low, ymax = Pred_high, fill = Index),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Equivalent recording hours per site",
    y = "Relative standard error (%)",
    title = "Reduction in variance of acoustic indices vs sampling effort",
    subtitle = "Weibull nonlinear regression ± 1 SD"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 9️⃣ Résumé modèles
for(ind in indices){
  cat("\n======", ind, "======\n")
  if(class(mod)[1] == "try-error"){
  print(paste("FAILED:", ind))
  }
}
```

```{r}
theme_soundscape <- function() {
  
  theme_minimal() +
    
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", colour = NA),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#CBD5E1", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    axis.text  = element_text(color = "#64748B", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#64748B", size = 12, face = "bold"),

    axis.line = element_line(color = "#64748B", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#64748B"),

    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#64748B"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#64748B", face = "bold")
  )
}

ggplot(Data_Globale_Tahiti, aes(x = HSA, y = S, fill = Hab)) +
  
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black") +
  
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Hab),
              method = "loess",
              span = 1,
              se = FALSE,
              level = 0.95,
              alpha = 0.2,
              linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = HSA, y = S),
              method = "loess",
              span = 1,
              color = "black",
              se = TRUE,
              linetype = "dashed",
              linewidth = 1,
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 3:11) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Hard Surface Area (%)",
    y = "Species Richness",
    fill = "Habitat type",
    color = "Habitat type"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette = "Pastel2",
    labels = c(
      "Urbain" = "Urban",
      "Suburbain" = "Suburban",
      "Forêt" = "Forest",
      "Prairie" = "Rural"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_color_brewer(
    palette = "Dark2",
    labels = c(
      "Urbain" = "Urban",
      "Suburbain" = "Suburban",
      "Forêt" = "Forest",
      "Prairie" = "Rural"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_soundscape()
```

```{r}
# 1️⃣ Préparer richesse native
DF_IA10 <- DF_IA10 %>%
  mutate(S_Natif = S - S_Exo)

# 2️⃣ Résumé par site
DF_richesse <- DF_IA10 %>%
  group_by(Enr) %>%
  summarise(
    S_Exo = mean(S_Exo, na.rm = TRUE),
    S_Natif = mean(S_Natif, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 3️⃣ Position verticale globale
y_top <- max(DF_IA10$AEI, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.15
y_bottom <- y_top - 0.08   # espacement entre les deux lignes

# 4️⃣ Graphique
ggplot() +

  geom_jitter(data = DF_IA10,
              aes(x = factor(Enr), y = AEI),
              width = 0.2,
              size = 1,
              alpha = 0.6,
              color = "grey20") +
  
  geom_boxplot(data = DF_IA10,
               aes(x = factor(Enr), y = AEI, fill = factor(`P/A_Natif`)),
               color = "black",
               width = 0.5,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  # 🔵 Richesse native (affichée seulement si > 0)
  geom_text(data = DF_richesse %>% filter(S_Natif > 0),
            aes(x = factor(Enr),
                y = y_top,
                label = paste0("N=", round(S_Natif,1))),
            size = 3,
            fontface = "bold",
            color = "#2E7D32",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # 🔴 Richesse exotique (affichée seulement si > 0)
  geom_text(data = DF_richesse %>% filter(S_Exo > 0),
            aes(x = factor(Enr),
                y = y_bottom,
                label = paste0("E=", round(S_Exo,1))),
            size = 3,
            fontface = "bold",
            color = "#B91C1C",
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#FCA5A5", "1" = "#BFE3C0"),
                    name = "Native presence") +
  
  labs(x = "Site",
       y = "AEI") +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")
```

On essaye de faire les correlations entre toutes les variables pour voir ce que ca donne..
```{r}
library(GGally)

data_selected <- DF_IA10 %>%
  select(
    `D_R_P`,              # Indice acoustique
    `D_M`,                # Richesse totale
    `D_B`,            # Richesse exotique
    `HSA`,
    `Arb`,
    `Arbu`,
    `Her`,# Richesse native
    S,
    S_Exo,
    `P/A_Myna`,# Exemple métrique paysage
    `P/A_Natif`      # Exemple variable bio
  )


cor_fun <- function(data, mapping, method = "pearson", ...) {
  x <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y <- eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)
  
  test <- cor.test(x, y, method = method)
  
  r <- round(test$estimate, 2)
  p <- test$p.value
  
  stars <- ifelse(p < 0.0001, "***",
           ifelse(p < 0.001, "**",
           ifelse(p < 0.01, "*", "")))
  
  label <- paste0("r = ", r, "\n", stars)
  
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = label, size = 4) +
    theme_void()
}


fig3 <- ggpairs(
  data_selected,
  lower = list(continuous = wrap("points", alpha = 0.6, size = 1)),
  upper = list(continuous = cor_fun),
  diag  = list(continuous = wrap("densityDiag"))
) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("Figure3_scatter_matrix.png",
       plot = fig3,
       width = 10,
       height = 8,
       dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
theme_soundscape <- function() {
  
  theme_minimal() +
    
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC", colour = NA),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#CBD5E1", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    axis.text  = element_text(color = "#64748B", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#64748B", size = 12, face = "bold"),

    axis.line = element_line(color = "#64748B", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#64748B"),

    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8FAFC"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#64748B"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#64748B", face = "bold")
  )
}
```
